Bulletin No: 08 MWA/26/08/21/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 21 August 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 22 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via
Mannarand from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via
Mannar, and from Matara to Pottuvil
via Hambantota will be rough at times
with strong gusty winds up to (50-60)
kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.5 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off
the coast extending from Negombo to
Pottuvil via Galle and Matara.
The naval and fishing communities are
requested to be vigilant in this regard.
